concept: Big Money: Tony Mack is back and the whole city knows it. A night-to-summer Milwaukee flex video: wet Third Ward streets, lakefront rooftops, brass-blasting warehouse parties and the money walk — success that brings the whole crew with him.
world: Milwaukee at night and in summer: Third Ward brick streets, lakefront skyline with the Art Museum wings, the Hoan Bridge, rooftops, clubs, a brass-section warehouse party, a mob-movie cigar lounge.
mood: high-energy gangster rap video, glossy and swaggering, gold and amber light against emerald and magenta neon, deep blacks, wet reflections
timeOfDay: night with neon and golden-hour summer days
wardrobe: black tee, gold Cuban chain, leather jacket, pinstripe suit for the mob scenes, sunglasses
why: A flex anthem with a brass hook: heavy condensed type that slams on the beat, money-green and gold, glitch and flash on the drops, beat-cut camera angles and call-and-response stamps like a real rap video.
